title: The return of Eddy Current Suppression Ring on Breaking and Entering
summary: Almost ten years after their last release, Melbourne’s much-loved Eddy Current Suppression Ring have put out a new album, All in Good Time. Breaking and Entering’s Lauren and Simon chat with Brendan and Mikey of the band about the record. They share the impetus for recording the new material, how their respective careers in visual arts and audio mixing informed the album making process, plus some of their favorite tracks from 2019.
